verdict.rationale: OpenHands documents an Enterprise offering that provides commercial capabilities and support, with licensed self-hosting or managed deployment. Its pricing page lists Enterprise SAML / SSO, which covers licensing, SSO, and commercial support for an organization-wide rollout. missing for 10: detailed documentation of support terms/SLAs and SSO configuration, independent or hands-on corroboration of the enterprise rollout.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can license an enterprise deployment with SSO and commercial support for organization-wide rollout

citations.quote: OpenHands Enterprise provides commercial capabilities and support for organizations that need licensed self-hosting or managed deployment options.
OpenHands Cloud is the managed commercial service for running OpenHands without operating your own backend and sandbox infrastructure.
